name: Persona Browser
description: Reads your own social feed through a real logged-in browser on a Mac and shows it on a clean profile page. Experimental; Facebook only.
author: Joinery

settings.name: persona_browser_endpoint
settings.label: Service Endpoint
settings.helptext: Base URL of the persona browser service on the Mac (tailnet address, no trailing slash).

settings.name: persona_browser_token
settings.label: Service Token
settings.helptext: Bearer token from the service's config.json on the Mac. Paste it once.

settings.name: persona_browser_hide_ads
settings.label: Hide ads from the feed
settings.helptext: When on, posts the ad-marking recipe flagged as advertisements are left out of the feed. Posts not yet judged still show.

settings.name: persona_browser_hide_reels
settings.label: Hide reels from the feed
settings.helptext: When on, short-video reels are left out of the feed.

settings.name: persona_browser_auto_block_ad_count
settings.label: Auto-block a sender after this many ad posts
settings.helptext: When the AI has judged this many of one creator's posts to be advertisements, that creator is added to Blocked Senders automatically. Unblocking them there is final — they are never auto-blocked again. 0 turns auto-blocking off.

settings.name: persona_browser_post_retention_days
settings.label: Delete posts older than (days)
settings.helptext: A post is permanently deleted this many days after it was first captured, together with its cached images. 0 keeps posts indefinitely.
